units: Billing and the primary provider view use USD. The advanced five-plan comparison uses arbitrary comparison units, not tokens or ChatGPT credits.

scenario_links.notes: Links contain all numerical assumptions for one simulator. Invalid ordinary simulation settings fall back to defaults with visible feedback; cost drafts retain empty, invalid and valid states and never silently become supplied zero. No user records or permission selections are encoded. Economics v5 includes raw input-servingCost/input-developmentCost/input-operationsCost/input-paymentFee drafts (up to 128 characters), shared receipt, review status and usage basis. Empty means not entered; invalid values remain visible and unused. v4 links preserve rejected supplied values as invalid drafts. v1/v2/v3 clear incomplete provider cost examples with a visible correction; advanced inputs and receipt are retained. All economics targets restore the same inputs.

billing.input: M = calculated metered charge, excluding base; S = 20 + M
order: Normalize metered charge and optional contribution to nonnegative cents
Apply the adopted B(S) rule using integer-cent comparisons
Tier adjustment = B(S) - S; may be positive or negative
Total payment = B(S) + optional Foundation donation
billing.ties: At 60,150,350 use the lower tier. Above 500 midpoint ties round upward: 524.99 -> 500; 525 -> 550.
billing.compute_interpretation: Author-provided concept anchors: 200 USD = 20x; 500 USD = 50x; continuation of 50 USD per 5x. This settlement formula does not specify the underlying compute meter or verify official entitlements.
billing.limits: Exact rule for this independent concept, not an official price or a claim of proven economics. No permanent $500 cap, hidden $200 ceiling, discretionary percent discount or tax. Both upward and downward settlement are explicit. Foundation donations remain separate from commercial revenue. No automatic charitable deduction or verified collection channel. Account-splitting incentives remain a commercial question.
billing.provenance: Author adopted the formula in follow-up discussion after Pasta Board. The historical source and original 106.40 -> 100 example remain unchanged.

origin_note.status: author-reported retrospective origin, supplied during review
origin_note.inspiration: Uber end-of-ride settlement and optional tip; Uber One as a membership analogy for the proposed $20 base
origin_note.boundary: Not a statement of Uber One pricing, endorsement, or charitable tax treatment. Complements the restaurant analogy in the source.

utility_intuition.status: author design analogy supplied during review; not a cost identity
utility_intuition.note: Compute as electricity + infrastructure; electricity as energy + infrastructure; oil as energy + infrastructure, with different grades. Suggests legible metering and explicit intelligence/service grades.
utility_intuition.boundary: Normalized units in this simulator do not model quality differences or establish personal/API/enterprise tariffs.

presentation.primary: One editable receipt: membership, usage, subtotal, adjustment, settled service bill, optional Foundation donation, total payment
presentation.donation: UI Foundation donation maps to scenario gift and bill().contribution; it is a separate proposed charitable gift, not commercial revenue
presentation.distinction: Subscription contribution is a financial metric after costs; it excludes voluntary donations.

formulas.contribution_ltv: contribution / (churn / 100) − cac; null at zero churn or a nonfinite perpetual estimate

subscription.limits: Fixed allowances are independent assumptions, not verified entitlements. Requested demand is held constant. Loyalty is a separate variant, not stacked with settlement. No voluntary contributions, credit losses, partnership returns, corporate overhead, R&D, taxes, discount rate, causally measured retention or cohort variation. Gross profit, contribution and LTV are not net income.
subscription.presentation: Fictional comparison, opened deliberately. Internal gp means balance after modeled delivery costs, not verified gross profit. Partial contribution excludes research and company overhead.

separate_scenarios.credit_loss: exposure × (pd / 100) × (lgd / 100); matching assumed time horizon, no underwriting
separate_scenarios.partnership_net_proceeds: investment × ((success / 100) × multiple − 1); failure returns zero; timing, fees and dilution excluded
separate_scenarios.founder_runway: 60000 cash / (30000 monthly cash expense − 25000 monthly cash collections) = 12 months; MRR alone does not establish cash collections
separate_scenarios.equity_fraction: investment / (pre-money valuation + investment); excludes pools, convertibles and other terms

limitations: All results are sensitivity illustrations, not proof of business viability, creditworthiness, investment merit or official features.

foundation_donation.channel_status: No donation channel is verified and no payment is collected
foundation_donation.tax_status: No deduction or tax saving promised; recipient and donor eligibility require verification

provider.receipt: Revenue = bill(M).adjusted; donations excluded; receipt and provider view share M
provider.cost_state: Raw draft strings are validated into empty/invalid/valid states with the same contract in UI, engine and link parser. Valid zero is explicit zero; empty and invalid never become supplied zero. Numeric slots and legacy Known flags are derived from drafts. All four must be valid and costsReviewed=1 with costBasis matching M before a balance. Editing costs invalidates review; changing M makes it stale. Clearing costs preserves receipt and unrelated assumptions.
provider.rounding: Keep percentage precision until final USD charge; exact decimal multiplication and half-away-from-zero cent rounding. Serving/development/operations allocations accept at most two decimals. The 0–20% fee range is a calculator bound, not a claim about processors.

formulas.monthly_balance: settled bill - servingCost - developmentCost - operationsCost - roundToCents(settled bill * paymentFee / 100)
formulas.expected_12_month_balance: monthly balance * sum((1 - leavingRate / 100)^t, t = 0..11) - additional customerAcquisition
formulas.loyalty: Discount min(monthlyBenefit, settled bill); recalculate payment fees; departures = leavingRate * (1 - retentionGain / 100); other allocations remain fixed per retained customer

provider.limits: No OpenAI cost estimate or margin inference. User allocations must count each expense once. Optional worksheet is before financing, taxes and omitted expenses. Foundation donations have a separate charitable destination and are excluded. It is not company profit, cash flow, break-even or contribution-margin accounting. Fixed/shared expenses need not vanish when a customer leaves. Negative reviewed results are visible. Original source corpus is unchanged.
